parameters.units: All parameters dimensionless mathematical test values; two cosine potential ports, no hardware calibration.
parameters.point_chart: Q_i=q_i+a*q_i^3+b*q_(i-1)^2 (predecessor term absent for i=0); P=DQ^(-T)*p
parameters.mass_damping: M(q)=DQ.T*M0*DQ; C(q)=DQ.T*C0*DQ; complete geometric inertia retained

reference.method: Independent DOP853 in original variable-mass coordinates

domain_and_input_diagnostics.control_scope: Two smooth cosine ports with i_a=i0_a-k_a(Phi_a-Phi_ref_a); exactly integrable closed potential, no arbitrary modal-force compensation or calibrated current limit.
domain_and_input_diagnostics.transport_K_scope: K at (z,t) is defined before discretization by exact inverse-flow pullback of K0 and approximated independently by DOP853; this costly diagnostic is NOT an algorithmic ingredient. Only three step samples per grid are claimed.

interpretation: Finite-dimensional synthetic method verification; no 3D rod/FSI/contact, learned-model or KAM claim.
